strategy.name: Wyckoff_Accumulation_Markup_VolConfirm
strategy.rationale: Technicals-only equity swing on MTF. Buys stocks that are in Wyckoff accumulation turning to markup, above the 200-DMA, with volume confirming price and a nearest-resistance/nearest-support reward:risk of at least 1.8. Sizing is off the technical stop below support; the 5-day cap is hard because MTF interest turns a slow winner into a loser. No fundamentals — this desk was deliberately scoped to what can be computed from price and volume alone, rather than pretending to read financials it cannot reach.
